title: MyPlac3
tagline: Check out the unique recommendations curated by your favorite communities!
description:
Where do you get your recs?

Today, review aggregation platforms like Yelp or Google Reviews are one size fits all. And the majority of consumers are suspicious of the content they are getting due to spams, etc. Meanwhile, personal recommendations are the #1 driver of consumer spending decisions based on one's preferences, integrity, and preferences.

That's where MyPlac3 comes in.

MyPlac3 Check out the unique recommendations curated by your favorite communities!
how_its_made: This project uses the Lens Protocol for our photo sharing feature and market discovery as a communally curated feature. It also uses the Lens GQL API to create profiles, fetch profiles, and fetch publication data. These API calls are responsible for the majority of data displayed in the app, which was helpful because it's a paginated API. WalletConnnect and WorldCoin are used for onboarding users to our platform. This is a bot-proof mechanism for safely onboarding users and preserving the integrity of content. The intention is to solidify privacy by remaining  anonymous. And we use the Chainlink Keeper as an automation system for refreshing our databases on each user's discover page. Everything is deployed on Polygon!
